Goal
* Please provide two examples, one odd input and one even input, to illustrate.

Output
* The notation of "!!" is not explained elsewhere in the statement. "n!! factorial" is "n factorial factorial factorial", which shouldn't be the intended meaning.

Constraints
* Please provide the upper bound of [[n]].

Cases
* These cases are the same:
  • Example (Test 1)
  • also Odd (Validator 3)
  Please revise either case to make them different.

* Please split the last pair into two pairs of edge cases (input is always 1 for one pair, and always 2 for the other pair).

Thanks.
